lemmas.primary_translation: to be in a situation characterized by turmoil, criticism, or conflict

definitions.text: være i en situasjon preget av oppstyr, kritikk eller konflikt
definitions.translation: be in a situation characterized by turmoil, criticism, or conflict (lit. a storm rages around)

examples.no: det stormet rundt partilederen etter mange dårlige målinger
examples.en: There was turmoil around the party leader after many poor poll results.

examples.no: noen trivest best når det stormer rundt dem
examples.en: Some people thrive best when there is turmoil around them.
